synthesis:draft.headline: Minimum five-minute RRP in VIC1 was −504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: Minimum five-minute RRP in the window was −504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (UTC+1000).
There were 197 five-minute intervals with RRP < $0 in the window.
A negative episode ran from 2026-07-28T11:50:00Z to 2026-07-28T20:15:00Z with 101 five-minute intervals; that episode's most negative RRP was −45.57834 $/MWh at 2026-07-28T12:00:00Z.
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the five-minute price minimum (interval end 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z) was 7052.43 MW.
Operational demand (30-minute) for the half-hour ending 2026-07-28 21:30 AEST (UTC+1000) was 7491.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand reported was 8131.0 MW.
A net interconnector flow sample at interval end 2026-07-28 17:30 AEST (UTC+1000) showed net export of 935.08 MW.

AEMO market notices for VIC1 in the same region/window are listed under published_findings and include a constraint automation invoked from 11:00 hrs (see [market_notice_144650]), a TRGBESS1 non-conformance notice (see [market_notice_144635]) and a Moorabool No. 2 220 kV Bus trip at 17:29 NEM time (see [market_notice_144667]).

possible_explanations.statement: Automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597A8B26 (market_notice_144650) might have affected interconnector transfer capability and dispatch outcomes around the event [market_notice_144650].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the invoked constraint set CA_SYDS_597A8B26 and check whether its equations were binding in dispatch at 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z and neighboring five-minute intervals (use constraint binding reports/dispatch binding flags).

possible_explanations.statement: Local excess supply relative to dispatch demand at the interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z might have produced a strongly negative RRP.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare generator bid/offered volumes and dispatched unit outputs around 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z to see whether negative or very low priced volumes were dispatched against the dispatch TOTALDEMAND (7052.43 MW, ev0485).

possible_explanations.statement: Large SCADA changes in some generators (examples: GPWFWEST −220.26 MW, VBB1 −125.4 MW, MACARTH −121.2 MW, CRWARPSF −106.0 MW, YENDONWF +104.04 MW) could have changed the marginal unit or dispatch sequence and so might relate to the price movements.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Map these SCADA changes (sampled at interval_end_utc values in the generation change output, e.g. 2026-07-28T05:35:00Z and 2026-07-28T17:30:00Z) to unit offer prices and rebids to see whether the marginal unit or cleared offers changed near 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO's non-conformance notice for TRGBESS1 (market_notice_144635) might be relevant to available capability or constraint equations referenced across 27–28 July [market_notice_144635].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check TRGBESS1 conformance records and the unit's dispatch and offers for 27–28 July (compare the non-conformance notice text and unit dispatch history) to see any linkage to constraint sets or capability the next day.
